name: Excite Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Excite Holdings Co., Ltd., formed in 1997 with its base in Minato-ku, Japan, operates platform services, broadband communications, and SaaS and DX solutions segments. Its platforms include woman excite, a media portal for working mothers, and excite news, which covers current events, entertainment and trending topics. It also offers a cloud-based business management system that centralizes management accounting, sales performance, forecasts and KPIs.
